title_en: Academic Year 2027 Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation Scholarship: Call for Nominations
summary: Korean nationals who are scheduled to register for the first semester of their third year in Spring 2027 and who wish to be nominated must complete the nomination form (Excel file) and email it to the department by Monday, 26 October 2026. Each department may nominate at most one student, and the College of Engineering will nominate one student in total; the final nominee will be notified on 28 October 2026 at 15:00 and must submit documents by 30 October 2026. The email address and contact are given in the original notice.
applies_to: Voluntary; for students who wish to be nominated. Applicants must hold Republic of Korea nationality and be scheduled to register for the first semester of the third year as of Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기). They must meet all three eligibility conditions: at least 12 credits completed in every regular semester, an overall percentage grade of 85 or higher across all semesters, and no disciplinary record under the university regulations (including academic discipline). Each department may nominate at most one student; the College of Engineering will nominate one student.

translation:
Title: Call for Academic Year 2027 Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation (한국지도자육성장학재단) Scholars

The Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation is selecting new scholars for academic year 2027 as described below. Students who wish to be nominated should complete the nomination form (Excel file) and send it by email by Monday, 26 October 2026. (The email address is given in the original notice.)

A. Eligible for nomination: holders of Republic of Korea nationality who are scheduled to register for the first semester of the third year as of the first semester (Spring) of academic year 2027.

B. Number of nominees: at most one per department (school). ※ The College of Engineering plans to nominate one student.

C. Eligibility: those who meet all three of the following conditions:
1) Completed at least 12 credits in every regular semester
2) Overall percentage grade of 85 or higher across all semesters
3) No disciplinary record under the university regulations (including academic discipline)
※ Preferential treatment: those with leadership experience and those with special talents receive bonus points in the document review (refer to the foundation's official letter).

D. Scholarship amount: full tuition or an academic incentive grant of 3,500,000 won.

E. Payment period: at most two years (support for at most four regular semesters).

F. College of Engineering nominee selection procedure
1) Submission of the department nomination form [Attachment 3]: Monday, 26 October 2026
※ At most one nominee per department. If no reply is received by the deadline, the department is regarded as having no nominee.
※ If applications exceed the quota (one), bonus-point candidates are selected first, and the nominee is chosen by evaluation based on grades for all semesters (grade point average and credits completed).
※ Please note in advance that, regardless of document submission, you may not be selected as the College of Engineering nominee or the Seoul National University nominee.
2) Notification of the final nominee to the department: Wednesday, 28 October 2026, 15:00
3) Document submission by the final nominee: Friday, 30 October 2026

G. Selection method: foundation document review and interview.

H. Required documents: scholarship application form, recommendation letter from the academic advisor, personal statement, academic transcript, consent forms for the collection, use and provision of personal information (foundation and university), consent form for participation in scholar obligations, and documentation for preferential treatment (applicable students only). ※ For readability, please complete the forms on a computer and then print them (excluding the signature).

Attachments (4) — their contents were not read:
- 2026학년도 한국지도자육성장학재단 장학생 추천서식 (1).xlsx (16 KB) [Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation scholar nomination form]
- 2027년도 제출서류 양식.zip (237 KB) [2027 submission document forms]
- 개인정보 수집·이용 및 제공 동의서(장학복지과_교외재단) (45).hwp (18 KB) [Consent form for collection, use and provision of personal information (Scholarship and Welfare Division, external foundations)]
- 장학생 선발관련 FAQ.pdf (96 KB) [FAQ on scholar selection]
